verdict.rationale: Canny ships a first-party MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor. Through it, users can ask natural-language questions about feedback, themes, ARR impact and the roadmap, and take actions such as updating statuses, linking deals, organizing requests and replying to customers. Natural-language operation therefore runs through external LLM clients rather than a native in-app assistant, and the evidence is vendor marketing only. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation of the full set of MCP tools and their limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
